blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Lanao del Sur provincial government has appealed anew to the families of the missing victims in the 2017 Marawi siege to submit DNA samples, as only over a hundred families of the 400 unidentified remains buried at the Maqbara Muslim cemetery in Marawi City have provided specimens. Abdul Mikhail Balindong, a member of the Technical Working Group (TWG) for the town hall meetings with families of the missing victims, provided the update while appealing for more DNA submissions so the unidentified bodies can be recognized and their kin can be formally notified.
